title: Sni445 recruits box C/D snoRNPs snR4 and snR45 to guide ribosomal RNA acetylation by Kre33
authors: Hafner J; Zierler I; Hamze H; Favre S; Thoms M; Kunowska N; Rimser S; Albert B; Caetano T; Aguirrebengoa M; Beckmann R; Stelzl U; Kressler D; Henras AK; Pertschy B
one_liner_zh: 该文研究酵母核糖体组装因子Sni445招募snoRNP引导rRNA乙酰化，属RNA-蛋白互作与核糖体生物合成，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Eukaryotic ribosome synthesis is a highly complex, multistep process that is best characterized in the yeast Saccharomyces cerevisiae . It is orchestrated by over 200 ribosome assembly factors and 75 small nucleolar ribonucleoproteins (snoRNPs), which guide site-specific chemical modifications of precursor ribosomal RNA (pre-rRNA). While canonical box C/D snoRNPs direct 2’-O-methylation, the atypical box C/D snoRNPs snR4 and snR45 mediate acetylation of 18S rRNA residues C1280 and C1773, respectively, catalyzed by the acetyltransferase Kre33. Here, we identify and characterize Ynl050c/Sni445 as a novel ribosome assembly factor and previously unrecognized auxiliary component of the snR4 and snR45 box C/D snoRNPs. Sni445 associates with snR4 and snR45 in their free form and is required for their stable incorporation into 90S pre-ribosomes. Genetic interactions link Sni445 and the snR4 and snR45 snoRNAs to ribosomal proteins Rps20 (uS10) and Rps14 (uS11), which are positioned near the respective acetylation sites in the 40S subunit. Moreover, Sni445 physically interacts with Kre33 within the 90S pre-ribosome, and its absence abolishes acetylation of C1280 and C1773. Our findings suggest that Sni445 facilitates the recruitment of snR4 and snR45 snoRNPs to 90S particles and might promote their interaction with Kre33, thereby enabling the site-specific acetylation of 18S rRNA by Kre33.
abstract_zh: 真核生物核糖体合成是一个高度复杂、多步骤的过程，在酿酒酵母（Saccharomyces cerevisiae）中得到了最充分的表征。该过程由超过200个核糖体组装因子和75个小核仁核糖核蛋白（snoRNPs）协调，这些因子指导前体核糖体RNA（pre-rRNA）的位点特异性化学修饰。虽然典型的box C/D snoRNPs指导2’-O-甲基化，但非典型的box C/D snoRNPs snR4和snR45分别介导18S rRNA残基C1280和C1773的乙酰化，这一过程由乙酰转移酶Kre33催化。在此，我们鉴定并表征了Ynl050c/Sni445作为一种新型核糖体组装因子，以及snR4和snR45 box C/D snoRNPs的先前未被识别的辅助组分。Sni445以其游离形式与snR4和snR45结合，并且是它们稳定整合入90S前核糖体所必需的。遗传相互作用将Sni445及snR4和snR45 snoRNAs与核糖体蛋白Rps20 (uS10)和Rps14 (uS11)联系起来，这些蛋白位于40S亚基中相应乙酰化位点附近。此外，Sni445在90S前核糖体内与Kre33发生物理相互作用，其缺失会消除C1280和C1773的乙酰化。我们的发现表明，Sni445促进snR4和snR45 snoRNPs招募至90S颗粒，并可能促进它们与Kre33的相互作用，从而使Kre33能够对18S rRNA进行位点特异性乙酰化。
